name: Apex EOD 50K
source: Account holder 2026-09-27: "the EOD trail apex with the max 6 con", $3,000 target, $2,000 EOD-trailing max loss, $1,000 daily loss limit, no consistency rule, passable in 1 day, floor locks at +$100. The daily limit is modelled SOFT (closed out and stopped for the day, the account survives), the same as Lucid's -- confirm if Apex's differs. Floor: $2,000 below the EOD peak, locking at $50,100 (+$100) once the EOD peak reaches +$2,100. CORRECTED 2026-10-11 from Apex's pages (https://apextraderfunding.com/help-center/eod-trailing-drawdown-accounts/eod-evaluations/, .../eod-drawdown-explained/, .../eod-payouts/, https://apextraderfunding.com/help-center/additional-helpful-items/scaling-levels-pa-explained/): the evaluation lasts 30 calendar days with no extension and no reset (21 weekdays here), and the payout block is now Apex's own: 5 days of $250 or more, the largest day under 50% of the profit, paid only from the profit above the $52,100 safety net, minimum $500, first payout at most $1,500. Not confirmed by the account holder.
notes: Max size 6 minis = 60 micros in the EVALUATION. The PA starts at 2 contracts (3 from +$1,500, 4 from +$3,000). NOT enforced by the simulator.
Trailing max loss is END OF DAY (recalculated at 16:59:59 ET from the closing balance, never down) and enforced in real time: touching it intraday, open losses included, fails the account.
The EVALUATION lasts 30 calendar days, no extension, no reset: `max_days` 21 weekdays, and the eval is not raced past them.

NOT MODELLED: in the evaluation the floor does not lock at $50,100 (Tradovate: it trails to the end; Rithmic / WealthCharts: fixed at $53,000). Here it locks at +$100 from +$2,100, as in the PA: between +$2,100 and +$3,000 the real floor is up to $900 higher, so the pass rate is slightly friendly.
No consistency rule and no minimum days in the evaluation: a single +$3,000 day passes.

SOFT daily loss limit $1,000 (open losses included), applied per trade from each trade's tick-level worst moment (MAE); stopped for the day, account survives. In the PA it rises to $2,000 / $3,000 with profit: NOT MODELLED.

PAYOUT, Apex's own: 5 days of $250 or more, the largest day under 50% of the profit since the last payout, paid only from the profit above the $52,100 safety net, minimum $500, first payout at most $1,500 (so the maximum first payout needs +$3,600). Only the first payout is simulated.
disclaimer: Eval rules from the account holder 2026-09-27; the 30-day limit and the payout terms are Apex's published ones (2026-10-11), not yet confirmed by the account holder.
payout_ladder: caps by payout number: $1,500, $1,500, $2,000, $2,500, $2,500, $3,000; six payouts, then the PA closes; 100% split
